thread:
maria: Quick PM follow-up: we need final owners and clear due dates for the action items from yesterday's postmortem. I put a first pass below. Please CLAIM or suggest a different owner by EOD.

aj: I can pick up the cache-TTL race fix (RWINF-510). Estimate: prototype + unit tests by Thu, patch and deployment by next Mon.

olivia: I'll own rollout verification and smoke tests for that change. Need a small window with capacity-ops to run a controlled burst. Also will prepare a checklist for post-deploy verification.

dave: I'll own the incident-correlation work (RWINF-511) to surface recurring patterns. Plan: run a regex-ish scan for stack traces, then hand off results to infra for prioritization. Kickoff Mon.

capacity-ops: We can offer a 2-hour controlled burst on Thu 18:00-20:00 PT. Please provide expected qps and a throttling plan.

maria: RACI proposal: R=AJ (implementation), A=Olivia (rollout verification), C=SRE team, I=Product & Support. I'll drop a short RACI doc in the ticket.

aj: created tickets: ```jira create RWINF-510 "cache TTL race condition" assignee:@aj due:2026-04-09 labels:pm-followup``` and ```jira create RWINF-511 "recurring incident analysis" assignee:@dave due:2026-04-16 labels:recurring-analysis```

incident-bot: RWINF-510 created by @aj and assigned to @aj. RWINF-511 created by @aj and assigned to @dave.

olivia: Quick design question: feature flag rollout vs traffic-canary? I'm leaning toward a flag so rollback is single flip. For verification, suggested criteria: no errors >0.5% and p95 latency change < 20ms for 15m window. Thoughts?

aj: agree on feature-flag; also propose incremental traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with metric checks at each step. Rollback triggers: error-rate >0.5% OR p95 increase >25ms for 5m.

sre-rotations-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff Fri 09:00 UTC. If an owner is changing during handoff, add handoff notes to the ticket and ping the on-call.

maria: Summary of actions: RWINF-510 (AJ) due 2026-04-09, RWINF-511 (Dave) due 2026-04-16, RACI doc (Maria) due 2026-03-31. Capacity-ops confirmed burst Thu 18:00-20:00 PT. Meeting to align: https://meet.redwood/pm-owners-2 15m Tue 11:00 PT. Please confirm in-thread by EOD.

aj: confirmed. will post PR and the feature-flag plan. :thumbsup:

dave: confirmed, I'll attach initial results to the ticket and schedule the weekly sync.

olivia: confirmed, I'll draft the smoke-test checklist and post it in the ticket.

maria: thanks all. I'll create the follow-up epic and add labels `pm-followup` and `recurring-analysis` so we can filter later. If anything changes, update the jira and ping here.
